name: scratchpad
description: A session-scoped workspace for temporary files and visually verified UI variants.

interface.shortDescription: Temporary workspace with visual UI verification
interface.longDescription: Scratchpad gives the agent its own working directory for every session and adds a visual design loop for UI work. The agent can build disposable web or native variants, render them, inspect the resulting pixels, and publish the actual images inside the Scratchpad tool result before changing the product. The directory is isolated from the project and swept after seven days.
defaultPrompt: Render three button variants in the visual scratchpad.
Compare this UI visually before changing it.
